news.headline: Okongwu accumulated 16 points (6-12 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 1-2 FT), 11 rebounds, one block and two steals in 36 minutes during Sunday's 113-106 win over Milwaukee.
news.story: The 25-year-old center saw his biggest workload of the season as the Hawks navigate multiple injuries to the frontcourt. Okongwu has played at least 30 minutes in every November game so far, averaging 16.3 points, 9.1 boards, 2.4 assists, 2.1 threes, 1.6 steals and 1.0 blocks while shooting 53.8 percent from the floor, and four of his five double-doubles this season have come during that stretch.

news.headline: Okongwu posted 17 points (7-13 FG, 2-7 3Pt, 1-2 FT), six rebounds, one assist, two blocks and two steals across 35 minutes during Friday's 125-117 overtime loss to the Bulls.
news.story: Okongwu is one of the best all-around centers in the league, and his newfound ability to hit threes, even though he went 2-for-7 on Friday, is encouraging for his fantasy profile. He's averaging 16.3 points, 8.8 rebounds, 2.8 assists, 1.5 steals, 1.0 blocks and 2.0 three-pointers made per game since the beginning of November.

news.story: Jokic tied with Jamal Murray for the team lead in scoring, and the big man led Denver in rebounds on the way to a double-double. However, his stellar effort wasn't enough to carry the Nuggets to a victory. Jokic continues to put up strong numbers across the board and is averaging 25.0 points, 12.6 rebounds, 8.4 assists, 1.4 steals and 1.0 blocks over his last five games.

news.headline: Sabonis finished Sunday's 125-103 loss to the Thunder with 11 points (3-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 5-6 FT), 13 rebounds and three assists in 29 minutes.
news.story: The veteran center's shot volume remains low as the Kings' offense re-focuses itself around rookie Darius Acuff. Sabonis has produced nine double-doubles in 12 games to begin the season, but over his last eight contests, he's averaging 11.8 points, 11.5 boards and 4.8 assists while attempting just 7.8 FGs a game, a drop of nearly four attempts a game from 2025-26.

news.headline: Sabonis ended with 21 points (9-16 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 12 rebounds and five assists over 35 minutes during Friday's 120-107 loss to the Trail Blazers.
news.story: Sabonis posted another double-double with 21 points and 12 rebounds, his usual efficient work in the paint. The big man remains the Kings' most reliable player even as losses keep piling up. He'll face a shorthanded frontcourt Sunday against the Thunder.
